"""保存第62轮恢复后重建的来源、实际日志、完整驱动源码及失败。"""

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
import traceback
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / "knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm"
PLAN_SHA = "38c989566dd18b5425305fce327fb28e9c56dd022f037f36f49399b60905d340"
BASELINE_SHA = "32adfecb9ff2e267419e13d042b00954d79047739f3d82881ad2becb7794af5a"
RESTORED = True
PREFIX = "v65-restored-build"
LOG_PREFIX = "iteration-ipm-v65-restored-build"


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(content):
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def sha(path):
    return digest(Path(path).read_bytes())


def unique_object(items):
    result = {}
    for key, value in items:
        require(key not in result, "JSON重复字段：" + key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def read_json(path, expected=None):
    content = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if expected is not None:
        require(digest(content) == expected, "输入身份不匹配：" + str(path))
    return json.loads(content.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique_object,
        parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("非有限JSON：" + value)))


def local_file(name):
    require(isinstance(name, str), "来源路径必须为字符串")
    relative = PurePosixPath(name)
    require(not relative.is_absolute() and relative.as_posix() == name and
        "\\" not in name and ":" not in name and
        all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in relative.parts), "来源路径不规范：" + name)
    target = (ROOT / name).resolve()
    require(target.is_relative_to(ROOT) and target.is_file(), "来源路径越界或缺失：" + name)
    return target


def file_map(expected):
    actual = {name: sha(local_file(name)) for name in expected}
    require(actual == expected, "文件已偏离预期身份")
    return actual


def main():
    record_path = DATA / (PREFIX + ".json")
    snapshot = DATA / (PREFIX + "-source.zip")
    log = ROOT / ".tools" / (LOG_PREFIX + ".log")
    saved_log = DATA / (PREFIX + ".log")
    detail = DATA / (PREFIX + "-ctest-detail.log")
    require(not any(path.exists() for path in (record_path, snapshot, log, saved_log, detail)),
        "禁止覆盖本轮已有构建证据")
    driver_bytes = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    record = {"driver_started_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "started_at_utc": None, "command": None, "returncode": None,
        "elapsed_seconds": None, "build_invocation_attempted": False, "source_sha256": {},
        "all_sources_sha256": {}, "sources_unchanged": None,
        "driver_source": driver_bytes.decode("utf-8"), "driver_sha256": digest(driver_bytes),
        "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA, "baseline_check_sha256": BASELINE_SHA,
        "error": None, "lp_runs": 0}
    returncode = 1
    before = None
    changed = []
    try:
        plan = read_json(DATA / "v65-plan.json", PLAN_SHA)
        baseline = read_json(DATA / "v65-baseline-check.json", BASELINE_SHA)
        require(plan["baseline_check"] == {"file": "v65-baseline-check.json", "sha256": BASELINE_SHA},
            "计划与真实基线不符")
        require(plan["starting_state"]["file"] == "v64-restored-state.json", "本轮基线必须为实际 v64 恢复状态")
        starting = read_json(DATA / "v64-restored-state.json", plan["starting_state"]["sha256"])
        require(baseline["passed"] is True and baseline["files"] == starting["files"] and
            baseline["libraries"] == starting["libraries"] and baseline["solver_sha256"] == starting["solver_sha256"],
            "真实基线与起始状态不同")
        anchor_path = DATA / ("v65-restored-source.json" if RESTORED else "v65-integration.json")
        anchor = read_json(anchor_path)
        require(anchor["passed"] is True and anchor["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA and
            anchor["baseline_check_sha256"] == BASELINE_SHA, "构建来源操作记录与计划不符")
        if RESTORED:
            require(anchor["files"] == baseline["files"] and anchor["binary_rebuild_required"] is True,
                "恢复后的来源与实际起始状态不同")
            libraries = anchor["libraries_before_rebuild"]
            executable_sha = anchor["solver_binary_before_rebuild"]
        else:
            require(anchor["before_files"] == baseline["files"] and
                anchor["libraries_before_and_after"] == baseline["libraries"] and
                anchor["solver_before_and_after"] == baseline["solver_sha256"], "集成前身份与真实基线不同")
            libraries = baseline["libraries"]
            executable_sha = baseline["solver_sha256"]
        changed = plan["changed_source_files"]
        require(len(changed) == len(set(changed)) == 10 and len(anchor["files"]) == 95 and
            len(libraries) == 17 and set(anchor["files"]) == set(baseline["files"]), "来源或库集合不完整")
        external_libraries = {name: value for name, value in libraries.items()
            if not Path(name).name.startswith("libsolver_")}
        require(len(external_libraries) == 8, "外部库集合不是预期八项")
        before = file_map(anchor["files"])
        file_map(libraries)
        require(sha(local_file("build/release/solver.exe")) == executable_sha, "构建前程序身份变化")
        record.update({"source_sha256": {name: before[name] for name in changed},
            "all_sources_sha256": before, "anchor_file": anchor_path.name,
            "anchor_sha256": sha(anchor_path), "starting_state_sha256": plan["starting_state"]["sha256"]})
        # 先保存并回读原字节；备份时发生并行来源修改也在调用构建前拒绝。
        with zipfile.ZipFile(snapshot, "x", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
            for name in sorted(before):
                archive.writestr(name, local_file(name).read_bytes())
        with zipfile.ZipFile(snapshot) as archive:
            names = archive.namelist()
            require(len(names) == len(set(names)) == 95 and set(names) == set(before), "构建来源快照成员不符")
            require({name: digest(archive.read(name)) for name in names} == before, "构建来源快照身份不符")
        file_map(before)
        file_map(libraries)
        require(sha(local_file("build/release/solver.exe")) == executable_sha, "备份期间程序身份变化")
        command = [r"C:\Users\ADMIN\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\native\powershell\pwsh.exe",
            "-NoProfile", "-File", str(ROOT / "scripts/build-windows.ps1"), "-Jobs", "4"]
        record["command"] = command
        test_log = ROOT / "build/release/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log"
        detail_before = (test_log.stat().st_mtime_ns, sha(test_log)) if test_log.exists() else None
        environment = dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8="1")
        # started_at_utc 严格在子进程调用前生成，不以完成记录时刻冒充开始。
        with log.open("xb") as output:
            record["started_at_utc"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
            begin = time.perf_counter()
            record["build_invocation_attempted"] = True
            try:
                process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment,
                    stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                record["returncode"] = process.returncode
                returncode = process.returncode
            finally:
                record["elapsed_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - begin
        if test_log.exists():
            detail_after = (test_log.stat().st_mtime_ns, sha(test_log))
            record["ctest_detail_fresh"] = detail_before != detail_after
            # 编译失败时可能仍留旧CTest明细，保存时显式标注，不冒充本轮回归。
            shutil.copy2(test_log, detail)
        else:
            record["ctest_detail_fresh"] = False
        after = {name: sha(local_file(name)) for name in before}
        record["sources_unchanged"] = before == after
        record["external_libraries_before_and_after"] = file_map(external_libraries)
        require(before == after, "构建期间来源发生变化")
        if returncode == 0:
            require(record["ctest_detail_fresh"] is True, "成功构建没有生成本轮CTest明细")
    except Exception:
        record["error"] = traceback.format_exc()
        returncode = 1
    finally:
        # 即使子进程失败或启动异常，也保留已有原始日志和完整驱动来源。
        if log.exists():
            shutil.copy2(log, saved_log)
        record.update({"completed_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "source_snapshot": str(snapshot) if snapshot.exists() else None,
            "source_snapshot_sha256": sha(snapshot) if snapshot.exists() else None,
            "log": str(log) if log.exists() else None, "log_sha256": sha(log) if log.exists() else None,
            "build_log": str(saved_log) if saved_log.exists() else None,
            "ctest_detail": str(detail) if detail.exists() else None,
            "ctest_detail_sha256": sha(detail) if detail.exists() else None})
        with record_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as target:
            json.dump(record, target, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
            target.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({key: record[key] for key in
        ("returncode", "elapsed_seconds", "sources_unchanged", "log", "error")}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if log.exists():
        print(log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")[-4000:])
    raise SystemExit(returncode)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
